line_or_section: notes item 7; protocol section 4 rule 4; kit route section 5
finding: Fix for P2B03 makes the registered test unrunnable with the kit as shipped. Note 7 now says rows measured with caches or prefetch on do not count and that, if no row is measured with them off, the refutation rule cannot be applied. The protocol asks for a cache off pass 'where the board allows it', but the preferred kit route has no way to switch caches or prefetch off: b1_main.c only reads FLASH_ACR back, build_b1.py has no cache option, and CHECKLIST.md and session_plan.csv never mention a cache off pass. Following the kit therefore yields zero counting rows and the model cannot be refuted. The note also does not address the second half of P2B03: the pqm4 training rows were themselves measured in the cached benchmark mode (protocol section 4 table), so 'no cache' is inconsistent with the data the model was fitted on, and excluding cached rows tests the model on conditions unlike its training data.
evidence: b1_main.c lines 81 to 83 print META,cache from FLASH_ACR ICEN/DCEN/PRFTEN and never write them; build_b1.py arguments are --platform, --sets, --iters only; grep -i cache in CHECKLIST.md finds only read back steps; BOARD_RUN_PROTOCOL.md line 43 (L4R5ZI benchmark mode: data cache, instruction cache and prefetch enabled).
suggested_fix: Add a build flag in build_b1.py and b1_main.c that clears ICEN, DCEN and PRFTEN (after a cache reset) before the timed loops, add the cache off pass to CHECKLIST.md and session_plan.csv, and add a dated note that states how the training rows' cached condition relates to the 'no cache' assumption.
